Inline native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell chrome native-safe: loading -> dimmed skeleton box (web Skeleton h-full rounded-xl); else GlassPanel with a header row (icon + uppercase muted title + DataFreshness) over the centered children body. DataFreshness is a native pill: relative 'updated' time from dataUpdatedAt with Updating…/Error/stale(warning) markers and a refresh Pressable wired to onRefresh — the web DataFreshness/PinButton/HelpTooltip/QueryError surfaces are browser-only and stay owned by WidgetShell's own future conversion turn.

Inline native WidgetEventFeed reproduces web ./shared/WidgetEventFeed: limit = maxItems ?? (compact?3:10); sorted = [...items] sorted by timestamp desc sliced to limit (useMemo deps [items,limit]); empty -> EmptyState message=emptyMessage??t('widget.noEvents','No events yet'); else a timeline (22px bordered dot tinted by item.color holding the status glyph, connector for all-but-last, baseline title/relative-time header row, muted 2-line subtitle). formatRelativeTime keeps the web buckets (<1m 'Just now', <60m 'Xm ago', <24h 'Xh ago', else formatDateTime); formatDateTime replaces the web useDateFormat().formatDateTime with a native toLocaleString, '—' on invalid input. The shared EventFeedItem.href drill-through is omitted because this widget never sets it. The web `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto` wrapper -> a flex View; per-widget scrolling is delegated to the outer native dashboard container, so no nested ScrollView is introduced.

No DOM elements, lucide-react, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router, or old web UI components are imported into the native output — only react, react-native (View/Pressable/StyleSheet), the canonical AppText/GlassPanel/SemanticIcon, the converted parity hooks, and theme tokens. tsc --noEmit, eslint --quiet, and jest --runInBand --detectOpenHandles all pass; the file is not referenced by existing tests (the web-parity tree is independent of apps/native/src/widgets).
